title: Many traders optimize their strategy, but don't consider key factors.
paragraph1: Real spreads, execution quality, commissions and holding costs can change your net result more than the strategy itself, for the same underlying and the same directional thesis.
paragraph2: Tradelia starts from your real CFD trading context and measures where cost becomes decisive. Not from the product, but from the real cost of the combination of asset, broker and horizon you are using.
quote: There is no universally best broker. There is the most efficient combination for your operational context.
card_note: Tradelia shifts the analysis from the product to the real cost of the broker + asset + horizon combination.
row_1_pattern: Asset, strategy, and horizon must be compatible with each other.
row_2_pattern: Real spreads and commissions hit on every entry and exit, before the thesis even develops.
row_3_pattern: Funding, rollover, and structural costs weigh on net results.
